action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ev=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=(ev?.toolInput?.path||ev?.tool_input?.path||'');const c=(ev?.toolInput?.content||ev?.tool_input?.content||'');const banned=['可能','大概','也许','或许','应该','估计','疑似','看起来','大约'];if(!/\.md$/.test(p)||!banned.some(w=>c.includes(w))){process.exit(0)}console.error('Banned hedging word in '+p);process.exit(2);"

hooks.description: Before the agent writes to a markdown file, block the write when the new content contains a banned hedging word (可能 / 大概 / 也许 / 或许 / 应该 / 估计 / 疑似 / 看起来 / 大约). A command hook that exits with code 2 blocks the triggering event.
hooks.name: Block banned hedging words in docs

action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ev=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=(ev?.filePath||ev?.toolInput?.path||ev?.tool_input?.path||'');const banned=['可能','大概','也许','或许','应该','估计','疑似','看起来','大约'];const files=p? [p] : fs.readdirSync('.', {recursive:true}).filter(f=>/\.md$/.test(f));let hit=false;for(const f of files){let c='';try{c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')}catch(e){continue}const found=banned.filter(w=>c.includes(w));if(found.length){console.error(f+': '+found.join(','));hit=true}}process.exit(hit?1:0);"

hooks.description: After the agent saves a markdown file, scan it for banned hedging words and report any hit so it is fixed in the same turn.
hooks.name: Check saved docs for banned hedging words
